epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure credit card transactions
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Setup Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Configure Stripe API keys, setup payment intent, and handle payment method

tasks.title: Implement credit card payment form and validation
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form, validate user input, and handle payment submission

tasks.title: Integrate payment processing with order management
tasks.description: Update order status, handle payment callbacks, and log payment events

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Implement subscription management features using Stripe
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to update their subscription plans and payment methods
The system cancels subscriptions and notifies customers via email when requested

tasks.title: Implement subscription plan management
tasks.description: Create, update, and delete subscription plans using Stripe API

tasks.title: Develop subscription update and cancellation functionality
tasks.description: Handle subscription updates, cancellations, and notify customers via email

tasks.title: Integrate subscription webhooks for payment events
tasks.description: Handle Stripe webhooks for subscription-related payment events

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track and manage payments
stories.description: Implement payment event handling, receipt generation, and email notifications
acceptance_criteria: The system generates receipts for successful payments and sends them to customers via email
The system notifies administrators via email for payment-related events, such as successful payments or failures

tasks.title: Develop payment event handling and logging
tasks.description: Handle payment events, log payment history, and update payment status

tasks.title: Implement receipt generation and email notification
tasks.description: Generate receipts for successful payments and send them to customers via email

tasks.title: Integrate email notification for payment events
tasks.description: Notify administrators via email for payment-related events

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system, so that I can access my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate user credentials and allow login with correct email and password
The system should display an error message when the user enters incorrect email or password
The system should redirect the user to the dashboard after successful login

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation
tasks.description: Create a function to validate user credentials and check against the database

tasks.title: Create login form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design a login form and handle form submission to authenticate the user

tasks.title: Implement redirect to dashboard after successful login
tasks.description: Create a redirect to the dashboard after the user is authenticated

stories.title: As a new user, I want to signup for an account, so that I can use the system
stories.description: The system should allow new users to signup using their email and password
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate user input and create a new account with the provided email and password
The system should send a verification email to the user after signup
The system should display an error message when the user tries to signup with an existing email

tasks.title: Implement user input validation for signup form
tasks.description: Create a function to validate user input and check for existing emails

tasks.title: Create signup form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design a signup form and handle form submission to create a new account

tasks.title: Implement email verification after signup
tasks.description: Create a function to send a verification email to the user after signup

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password using their email
acceptance_criteria: The system should send a password reset email to the user with a reset link
The system should allow the user to reset their password using the reset link
The system should display an error message when the user tries to reset their password with an invalid email

tasks.title: Implement password reset email functionality
tasks.description: Create a function to send a password reset email to the user

tasks.title: Create password reset form and handle form submission
tasks.description: Design a password reset form and handle form submission to reset the user's password

tasks.title: Implement password reset link validation and password update
tasks.description: Create a function to validate the password reset link and update the user's password

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth, so that I can access my account easily
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub
acceptance_criteria: The system should redirect the user to the OAuth authorization page
The system should authenticate the user using the OAuth authorization code
The system should display an error message when the user's OAuth authentication fails

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authorization flow with Google
tasks.description: Create a function to redirect the user to the Google OAuth authorization page and handle the authorization code

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authorization flow with GitHub
tasks.description: Create a function to redirect the user to the GitHub OAuth authorization page and handle the authorization code

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authentication and login
tasks.description: Create a function to authenticate the user using the OAuth authorization code and login the user

acceptance_criteria: The system can send welcome emails to users with account information

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to monitor and log email sending errors, so that I can troubleshoot issues
stories.description: Monitor and log email sending errors for debugging and troubleshooting purposes
acceptance_criteria: The system can log email sending errors with error messages and timestamps

acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays a list of all user accounts
Administrators can create new user accounts with unique usernames and passwords
Administrators can edit existing user account information, including roles and permissions
Administrators can delete user accounts and receive a confirmation prompt before deletion
